pmsLock.title: Import PMS data to unlock: 14-day revenue, rooms booked, suggestion results
pmsLock.body: These figures only come from your PMS. Revenue and rooms booked are never estimated from Booking.com advertised rates.
pmsLock.viewer: Ask your hotel admin to import PMS data in Settings › PMS import.

revenue.title: Revenue, next 14 days (PMS)
revenue.info: Revenue on the books per night from the PMS data you import. Nights without revenue use rooms sold × ADR (average rate per room sold, from your PMS).
revenue.caption: revenue on the books · {known}/14 nights with data

outcomes.title: Suggestion results
outcomes.subtitle: Price suggestions you marked “I changed the price” or “Dismiss”, and what happened after the stay.

card.title: Recorded suggestions → results
card.description: Last {days} days. Occupancy and ADR are real PMS figures after the stay.
card.info: Right direction: raised and occupancy still reached 85%, or lowered and reached 70%. Needs review: raised and occupancy stayed under 60%, or lowered and stayed under 50%. Re-check: re-runs the suggestion on competitor rates {lead} days before each past night.
card.goodHint: Out of {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} with PMS figures
card.reviewHint: Raised and rooms went unsold, or lowered and still unsold
card.backtestNone: Not enough nights with PMS figures yet
card.emptyBody: Results appear after the stay once you have imported PMS data for that night and marked the suggestion “I changed the price” or “Dismiss” on Today.
card.adrTitle: ADR: average rate per room sold, from your PMS
card.upcomingHint: recorded by mistake? Press Undo; the suggestion returns on Today
